notes.title: Demo 0.0.1 hotfix released!
notes.notes:
I have released a small hotfix update to address issues regarding saving the game.
Players would sometimes get locked when trying to save the game, this issue should now be resolved.

On top of this, some minor animation issues have been corrected.

notes.title: Legends of Mythology Demo now available!
notes.notes:
As revealed in the recently unveiled demo gameplay trailer, I am thrilled to announce the official release of the demo!

You can (re)watch the gameplay trailer by clicking on the link below:
[previewyoutube=e1axPU-XXJk;full][/previewyoutube]

The demo features the starting area, as well as 'the countryside' and glimpses of other regions that you'll be able to fully explore in the future.

Even at this stage, you can meet NPCs, interact with critters, face off against enemies, and confront the game's very first boss!

I am committed to enhancing the demo by continually expanding the world and creating more content. Stay tuned for further updates.

Now, venture forth and discover how well ye fare!

notes.title: Legends of Mythology Demo Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
The gameplay demo release trailer for the Legends of Mythology Demo has been released!

Watch the trailer here:
[previewyoutube=e1axPU-XXJk;full][/previewyoutube]

Almost five years in the making as a hobby project and I now have something playable for you to get in your hands!

The demo releases at 26/09/2023 at 14.00 CEST.

Stay tuned!
